canonical_project: LG CNS Incheon Center / V-ENS Incheon Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists LG CNS Incheon Center in Gyeyang-gu, Incheon, as an operational facility opened in 1992. LG CNS marketing material identifies the Incheon Data Center/V-ENS Incheon Center at Hyoseong 2-dong, Gyeyang-gu with 7,000 sqm dedicated area. Public MW capacity was not found.
